text:
sara: heads-up — planning v2 cutover Thu 22:00 UTC. want to gate by client-side probe success (avoid blind rollout). thoughts?

dan: :thumbsup: i like a staggered slice. propose initial 2% (if shim not ready) or 5% otherwise. probe criteria: p95 latency <200ms AND probe error-rate <0.5% over a 10m window. if either breaches, auto-pause and alert ops.

liam: we can wire a telemetry gate into deploybot. question: are probes the SDK emits, or the API gateway prober?

ops: gateway prober is preferred since some older SDKs don't send the new header. gateway can inject X-Client-Probe: v2-check for canary traffic. will that work for everyone?

sara: yes, gateway shim is the fallback. if shim not merged, reduce initial slice to 2% and require explicit SDK probe metric. we'll note that in release notes.

dan: deploybot, can you add a preflight gate that fails the rollout if the probe criteria breach for 10m? we want auto-pause + @ops paging.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled rollout set for 2026-03-26T22:00Z. preflight gates available: service_health, schema_check, custom_metric. use: `/deploy add-gate --name client_probe --metric probe_success_rate --threshold 99.5 --window 600` to require >=99.5% success over 600s. will send alert to #oncall-ops on pause.

liam: thanks — i'll add the gate config to the rollout job. also suggest a soft-fallback route: if probe missing for >20% of sampled requests, divert those tenants to v1 and flag them in telemetry so we can follow up.

ops: ack. i'll start a PR for gateway shim and update the infra playbook. if PR not merged by EOD tomorrow, we go 2% initial slice.

sara: rollback policy: immediate rollback if any tenant pins v1 or if deploybot gate pauses twice in a row. dan, can you draft a minimal rollback checklist?

dan: short checklist: `1) /deploy rollback --tag v1-fallback 2) verify traffic shift restored 3) run smoke tests: auth, simple generate 4) notify customers + status page update 5) open incident if >5% affected` i'll paste the exact steps to the incident template.

liam: one more note for release notes: call out header `X-Client-Probe` + guidance for SDK teams to opt in and how to verify metrics in telemetry. keep it prominent.

sara: agreed. i'll update release notes and add a small blurb in Deploybot job description. thanks all — will reconvene Tue 16:00 UTC for final signoff. :eyes:
